title: One-Minute Reset
steps: Unclench your jaw and lower your shoulders.
Let it out a little more slowly than you breathed in.
closing: Take a moment before moving on. There is no need to rush.

title: Pause and Reset
steps: Notice where your body is touching the chair or floor.
Breathe in gently through your nose.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Repeat 4 times at a comfortable pace.
closing: Bring your attention back to what is around you.
